newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: COMMISSION TO DISCUSS LIETUVA PRIVATISATION.
newsitem.headline: COMMISSION TO DISCUSS LIETUVA PRIVATISATION.

text.p: The government said on Monday that the privatisation commission was expected to decide on the terms and privatisation programme for the country's biggest hotel, the Lietuva.
"The privatisation commission is to discuss today the programme for the Hotel Lietuva," the head of privatisation at the European Affairs ministry, Vytenis Junevichius, told Reuters.
"The privatisation tender for the hotel is to be announced in the near future," Junevichius added.
The state owns 70.04 percent stake of the hotel, a skyscraper style building built in the Soviet era.
It had a 817,000 litas net profit and turnover of 10.7 million litas in 1996 and net profit of 206,000 litas and 3.95 million litas turnover in the first five months of the year.
